rules.statement: On the execution of deed P1, Kiribanda became entitled to the half-share owned by Dingiriamma in the 20 lands, which ceased to be 'paraveni' property and assumed the character of 'acquired' property.
rules.supporting_quote: "Therefore this half share on the execution of P1 ceased to be 'paraveni' property and it assumed the character of 'acquired' property in the hands of Kiribanda."
